$Comment: The stamina half of Martha's dishes: eating a Harvest Salad or Martha's Roast puts it on. Shaped like the game's best fruit and vegetable buff (FruitVeggie_Buff_T3), stronger and longer: max stamina times 1.40 where the game's is 1.30, and 0.07 stamina back every tenth of a second (DamageCalculatorCooldown) where the game's gives 0.05, for 600 seconds (ten minutes) where the game's lasts six. Overwrite means eating another dish restarts it, never stacks it; each dish also clears the game's own fruit and vegetable buffs as it lands. Tune Amount or Duration here and both dishes follow; their descriptions in items.lang write these numbers out (Stamina Boost IV), so change them with it.
Name: items.effect.harvest_feast_food_stamina.name
